name: Spicy Gecko 96
author: LightAndy1
description: Rounded light cyan email input that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #d6f1ff to #fff. On focus, background-color changes from #d6f1ff to #d6f1ff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Spicy Gecko 96</title>
<style>
/* Spicy Gecko 96 by LightAndy1 — https://uiverse.io/LightAndy1/spicy-gecko-96 */
.input {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  outline: 2px solid #00a6fb;
  border: 0;
  font-family: "Montserrat", sans-serif;
  background-color: #d6f1ff;
  outline-offset: 3px;
  padding: 10px 12.5px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  width: 250px;
}

.input:hover {
  background-color: #fff;
}

.input:focus {
  outline-offset: -6px;
  background-color: #d6f1ff;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input class="input" placeholder="Email" type="email">

</body>
</html>
